name: Eronos
source:
Admiral of the Navy, Grand Duke of the South, and the Emperor's younger brother. As one of the Fallen, he has gathered subordinates who are likewise Fallen. As leader of the Southern Navy, he may be far from the centre of power, but he commands a substantial military force.

[From [url=https://pirahus.com/en/]official website[/url]]
